summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the timeline for developing a dashboard that calculates impressions, which is expected to follow the launch of 'Lidar' data. Initially, [p1] suggested a target date around mid-to-late November. [me] revised this estimate, stating that while the formula implementation itself should take only a couple of days, factoring in necessary adjustments and coordination, a release date of November 9th–10th was proposed as the latest possible deadline.

Regarding dashboard functionality, it was decided that 'share of time' would be calculated client-side (on the fly), while server requests would only be needed for filtering by facility and time period. Furthermore, [me] provided a SQL query structure to help [p1] populate an `ml_model` attribute within the asset data for better sensor identification across different models.
decisions: The dashboard release date is tentatively set for November 9th–10th, accounting for necessary adjustments and coordination.
'Share of time' will be calculated client-side (on the fly) rather than requiring a server request.
Server requests for the dashboard are limited to filtering by facility and period time.
action_items: Someone needs to populate the `ml_model` attribute using the provided SQL structure to categorize sensors/assets.
